notes.title: Christmas is coming to Rivalia 🎅🎄
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42649594/a2375727a7bcaa585d8ddf0a0a4c4745b51e8762.png[/img]

[h1]Christmas is coming to Rivalia[/h1]🎅🎄

Come on in and enjoy the Christmas spirit now! Go through our most epic scenarios completely covered in snow.  ⚔🎭

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42649594/41354927c1b50174ab8c972c0a5faaaf89181f9c.png[/img]

Rivalia: Dungeon Riders is a [b]roguelike with action-RPG[/b] gameplay in which we take control of a group of [b]heroes trapped in a time loop[/b] who must break the curse that grips the castle. Choose between [b]Ashelin, Halmor, Yhorm and Evanya[/b] and switch between them at any time in a totally organic way as you progress through [b]6 procedurally generated[/b] levels, loaded with [b]action, traps and challenges of all kinds[/b] as you hunt down Ciceron and his minions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42649594/cba9bcf37a881d2f205ac85023c1979c6ca065ec.png[/img]

[b]Featured content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Break the curse of Rivalia's castle throughout [b]6 procedurally generated levels[/b].
[*] Enjoy completely original games every time you start over, thanks to the game's [b]randomized dungeon system[/b].
[*] Switch instantly between [b]4 heroes with completely different personalities and skills[/b] and discover the most effective strategies to fight against every enemy and boss that will try to prevent your progress.
[*] Get [b]resources and materials[/b] with which to [b]create powerful upgrades[/b] that will help you emerge victorious.
[*] Enjoy the [b] lighthearted tone and cartoon aesthetics[/b] based on your [b]favorite role-playing games[/b] and stop the feet of the diabolical Ciceron.
[*] [b]Now available on [url=https://store.playstation.com/es-es/product/EP0811-CUSA27721_00-8929387558275941]PS4[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1872500/Rivalia_Dungeon_Raiders/]Steam.[/url][/url][/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Rivalia's spooky 1.02 update is here!
notes.content:
[h1]Halloween event details[/h1]
[list]
[*] The event will be available from the 24th of October until the 2nd of November.
[*] The lobby will be decorated with the event's own aesthetics.
[*] Enemies that inhabit the graveyard will change their appearance to fit the festival.
[*] The graveyard dungeons will also be decorated with new details, such as pumpkins and ravens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42649594/c81fa41ae5e3c2f3db39441c874499cdb20d12c7.png[/img]

[*] Among these new decorations, there will be breakable pumpkins that will contain 2 new materials exclusive to this event: Pumpkin and Silver Ingot.
[*] Using the new materials will unlock 2 new exclusive rune sets available for forging: Pumpkin Rune and Moon Rune.
[*] Once the event is over, you will keep the materials and runes obtained. The event's exclusive runes will still be available for forging in the forge, but you will no longer be able to obtain materials within the dungeons.
[/list]

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*] If you select the controller as the default device and is disconnected, the mouse and keyboard controls will be activated until the controller is connected again.
[/list]

[h1]Balance changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased Sacrum's magic damage and health. Increased health of Skeletons summoned by Sacrum.
[*] Increased physical damage and health of Spinefeld and Marrow.
[*] Increased Ciceron's physical and magic damage and reduced his armour.
[*] Reduced magic damage of Flying Cyclops.
[/list]

notes.title: Rivalia: ¿Spooky? Raiders
notes.content:
[h1]Halloween event comes to Rivalia![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42649594/130173a5c8eb1d90400f5bb4c128e60695784062.png[/img]

Welcome to the spookiest festival in the kingdom of Rivalia! Ciceron is a jester of tradition and he wasn't going to miss the chance to decorate his newly acquired castle for the occasion. What's new in this event?

[h2]Event details[/h2]
[list]
[*] The event will be available from the 24th of October until the 2nd of November.
[*] The lobby will be decorated with the event's own aesthetics.
[*] Enemies that inhabit the graveyard will change their appearance to fit the festival.
[*] The graveyard dungeons will also be decorated with new details, such as pumpkins and ravens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42649594/c81fa41ae5e3c2f3db39441c874499cdb20d12c7.png[/img]

[*] Among these new decorations, there will be breakable pumpkins that will contain 2 new materials exclusive to this event: Pumpkin and Silver Ingot.
[*] Using the new materials will unlock 2 new exclusive rune sets available for forging: Pumpkin Rune and Moon Rune.
[*] Once the event is over, you will keep the materials and runes obtained. The event's exclusive runes will still be available for forging in the forge, but you will no longer be able to obtain materials within the dungeons.
[/list]
[h2]Moon Rune[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42649594/a9fee6d230d14d4ee8233298a39b955071317f28.png[/img]

As the full moon rises over the graveyard, wolves howl and skeletons rise from their graves. This is the ideal time to equip your heroes with the moon set, which will increase your luck (critical chance) by 25 while in a graveyard dungeon, as well as boosting your offensive stats.


[h2]Pumpkin Rune[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42649594/575c1238660128e8a52933edf1f64cd933e3c3b3.png[/img]

Do you want to dress up for the occasion too? Then pumpkin runes are perfect for you. They won't give you any additional effects for equipping the full set, but they will increase your defensive capabilities and give you a creepy look.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42649594/a01f4a1620c7b4d214bfe5ddca3e53b0f0c91b97.png[/img]

notes.title: Rivalia: Dungeon Raiders out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42649594/98ddbef03ae728439711f5cb7d462f095f4cb1d0.png[/img]

[h1]Rivalia: Dungeon Raiders out now![/h1]

Have you ever imagined waking up to find yourself trapped in a time-space loop with 3 complete strangers? In the fantasy world of Rivalia, anything is possible. After some recent events in the castle, the court jester alters the space-time inside, leaving the 4 protagonists trapped and forced to work together to find a way to end the curse affecting the kingdom and escape.

To achieve your goal, you will take control of a character by traversing random dungeons and engaging in real-time combat. But you won't fight alone, your allies will fight alongside you and you can take control of them at any time. Each character will have a unique skill set, which can be expanded with additional passive effects thanks to the equipment you can forge. Knowing each character's strengths and equipping them correctly will be key to success.

[b]Only you can defeat the jester[/b].
